structured_output.what_is_happening: "New guy is chill" is a trend meme, likely spun off the Chill Guy meme and a TikTok search trend (the project's "website" is a TikTok search URL). At least 11 same-name NEWGUY tokens launched within about 15 minutes. This one (F99…) came out of a Meteora virtual curve and migrated instantly. It was created about 138s after the current leader (2drAsp…, $877k mcap, $1.13M volume in the first hour, $73k liquidity). It has pumped +150-200% to about $135-159k and got about 2,000 unique buyers against only 149 unique sellers. That lopsided ratio suggests spillover buying from people chasing the ticker, or bots. The linked X post is a status by "FirstCoinLaunch", a launch-alert style account, not the project's own account.

narrative.description: A 'new guy is chill' meme trend on TikTok, a Chill Guy variant. Many deployers are racing to launch it.
narrative.why_spreading: A TikTok trend meme plus rapid-fire copies. The leader's $1.1M of volume in its first hour shows real speculative demand for the name, though most of it goes to the leader, not this contract.

token_connection.why_this_token: Second by market cap among the same-name clones. Its liquidity is about half the leader's, and it launched later. The instant migration off a Meteora curve looks like a quick-deploy copy.
token_connection.competing_tokens: 2drAspMdBZQbm5YnrCWsX4gQPkwqrL4NxYZVr236BdP9 is the clear leader ($877k mcap, $73k liquidity, $1.13M volume in the first hour, earlier launch). There are about 9 other clones, most already dead with zero liquidity.

authenticity.evidence: GMGN tags 105 bundler wallets and 9 snipers. The buyer/seller split is extreme (2,008 unique buyers vs 149 sellers). No smart-money or KOL wallets are tagged. The X link points to a launch-alert account (FirstCoinLaunch), not an organic community. No paid DexScreener boosts.
authenticity.uncertainty: I could not load X (HTTP 402). Web search found nothing about this token, so I can't separate organic TikTok demand from clone-sniping bots.
